reward: negative mean total queue count over the simulation steps covered by one environment step
notes: The 300 vehicles/hour per approach, 300-second episode, and 15-second decision interval define this engineering pilot only; they are not validated research settings.
The 15-second interval was selected after observing the generated 3-second yellow clearance; switching leaves 12 seconds on the target green before the next decision.
The 20-episode-per-state training run and three-seed evaluation are a reproducible engineering pilot, not a statistically powered comparison.
Mean waiting time is the arithmetic mean of SUMO TripInfo waitingTime for completed vehicles only; vehicles unfinished at episode end are excluded.
A pilot run is not evidence that the DQN learned or that one state representation is better.
